Accept regeneration, or add a one-shot maintenance rename script outside src/?

recommended_responses: Add a one-shot maintenance script outside coverable_roots: ~30 lines, avoids hours of GPU regeneration, and is not a legacy read path in production code.
Yes: update the same snapshots preserving IDs per the Durable Requirements Contract, and add a new mirror set modeled on the Speech Blocks consolidation requirements.

data.understanding: Consolidate the Audio Blocks operation onto one authoritative audio_blocks.json document (status, voice_language, input_fingerprint, checkpoint, blocks[]), mirroring the Speech Blocks single-document precedent. Per-block payload drops from 25 to 7 fields. audio_blocks_report.json and audio_blocks_state.json are removed and their loaders become projections. Generated audio paths become a pure function of speech_block_id (audio_blocks/<speech_block_id>.wav), which removes audio_relative_path, metadata_relative_path, generated_part_relative_paths and the whole artifact remap mechanism. Hard break: no legacy read path.

data.summary: 9 REQ-NO-VERIFICATION findings, all of them the 9 new Planned Audio Blocks requirements awaiting linked tests at the check gate. No REQ-SPEC-MISSING and no other findings, so the pre-existing traceability baseline is otherwise clean.

Created 9 Planned Audio Blocks single-document requirements mirroring the Speech Blocks consolidation set, and updated 9 existing Active snapshots in place preserving their IDs. All 18 point at spec .agentic/specs/audio_blocks_document.spec.md.

12 failed in 0.18s. Red-before-green baseline: every failure is the missing single-document API (write_audio_blocks_document, load_audio_blocks_document, AudioBlocksDocumentError, AUDIO_BLOCKS_DOCUMENT_FILE_NAME, derived artifact paths).

Implementation complete and lint-clean (ruff check . passes on src and tests). New contract suite green 12/12. Legacy fixture migration in progress: failures went 88 -> 71 -> 51. Remaining by module: audio_blocks_service 19, audio_assembly_service 12, audio_blocks_ui_controller 8, characters_ui_controller 4, project_workspace_service 3, speech_blocks_state_service 2, audio_assembly_state_service 2, narator_voice_ui_controller 1. Cause is uniform: fixtures write the superseded list format and speaker-named WAVs.
Lint gate passes across src and tests after the single-document migration.

Session handoff: work paused for a fresh-context session. Branch refactor/audio-blocks-single-document, no commit and no push per operator instruction. Stage is check because tests are being rewritten against the new contract.

Fixture migration surfaced five source defects in the consolidation, all fixed: (1) _attach_current_speech_block_fields did not recompute pause_duration_ms/special_block_status, so a reloaded pause block fell back to the 1000ms default instead of the 500ms parsed from its Speech Blocks text; (2) six _persist_cancelled_state call sites still passed the pre-consolidation argument list (TypeError on any cancel during generation); (3) _attach_derived_audio_path set audio_relative_path unconditionally, breaking the pre-refactor invariant that a set path means generated audio exists, which Audio Assembly inclusion checks rely on; (4) _merge_existing_audio_blocks dropped the persisted audio_can_play flag while the resplit-reconcile path carried it; (5) load_audio_blocks derived the path before Speech Blocks enrichment so content_kind was unavailable.

data.rationale: One authoritative document removes the report and state artifacts that duplicated data recomputable from the block list.
data.requirement: Audio Blocks shall persist all operation metadata and blocks in a single authoritative audio_blocks.json document with a fixed top-level field set, and shall not create audio_blocks_report.json or audio_blocks_state.json.
data.verification: Automated contract test: writing a document produces only audio_blocks.json with the fixed root field set, and the report/state config constants are gone.

data.rationale: Every other former field duplicated Speech Blocks data, was constant per run, or was never read back, so persisting it invited drift between two sources of truth.
data.requirement: Each persisted Audio Block entry shall carry only speech_block_id, voice_target_id, generated, approved, audio_can_play, audio_duration_seconds, and generation_fingerprint, plus split_part_count and split_plan_fingerprint only when the block was split.
data.verification: Automated contract test: persisted blocks carry exactly the seven contract fields, plus the two split fields only when split_part_count > 1.

data.rationale: speech_block_id is the block's stable primary key, so a name derived from it cannot drift from the block that owns it and needs no stored path or rename pass.
data.requirement: The generated audio path for an Audio Block shall be derived from speech_block_id alone as audio_blocks/<speech_block_id>.wav, and the document shall not persist any audio path field.
data.verification: Automated contract test: the WAV and split-part paths equal audio_blocks/<speech_block_id>.wav and .../parts/<speech_block_id>_partNNN.wav, with no speaker name and no persisted path field.

data.rationale: The previous remap pass existed solely to repair names keyed on unstable chunk, sequence, and speaker inputs.
data.requirement: Audio Blocks shall not rename or remap a generated audio artifact when a preserved block changes, because the derived name depends only on the unchanged speech_block_id.
data.verification: Automated contract test: the artifact remapping helper no longer exists on the service.

data.rationale: Projections keep the consolidation invisible to the UI controllers, state services, and project-open repair that already call these loaders.
data.requirement: load_audio_blocks_report() and load_operation_state() shall return projections derived from the single Audio Blocks document that match the shapes their existing consumers read.
data.verification: Automated contract test: load_audio_blocks_report() and load_operation_state() return projections whose counts, stage status and metadata match the document.

data.rationale: The checkpoint is the only unique content the removed state artifact held, and it must survive the consolidation intact.
data.requirement: Audio Blocks resume shall read run_token, current_phase, current_block_id, next_speech_block_index, and next_split_part_index from document.checkpoint so block-level and split-part-level progress both continue.
data.verification: Automated contract test: the projected resume checkpoint exposes run_token, current_phase, current_block_id, next_speech_block_index and next_split_part_index.

data.rationale: The consolidation is an intentional hard break; silently reading pre-change artifacts would resurrect the format being removed.
data.requirement: A legacy list-format audio_blocks.json or a missing document shall be treated as not-started, and no legacy report or state file shall be read.
data.verification: Automated contract test: a legacy list payload reads as not-started and no legacy report or state file is read.

data.rationale: A strict root field set keeps the single document self-describing and prevents partial legacy payloads from loading.
data.requirement: An invalid Audio Blocks root contract shall be rejected.
data.verification: Automated contract test: writing an incomplete root raises AudioBlocksDocumentError and an unexpected root key set reads as not-started.

data.rationale: Reset must leave no pre-change artifact that a later read could mistake for current state.
data.requirement: reset_audio_blocks shall remove the single audio_blocks.json document and any residual legacy audio_blocks_report.json and audio_blocks_state.json files so the operator can regenerate cleanly.
data.verification: Automated contract test: reset_audio_blocks removes audio_blocks.json plus residual legacy report and state files.

data.summary: Operator-visible incident: an inspection command chained a bare 'git stash', which shelved the entire in-flight fixture migration and source fixes. Recovered with 'git stash pop' (no conflicts, all edits verified present). An AEGIS test gate that was running in the background during the stash window read the reverted tree; that run was stopped and discarded, and both gates were re-run against the restored tree. No commit, push or PR was made at any point.

Activated the 9 Planned single-document requirements against selectors in tests/test_audio_blocks_single_document_contract.py. Also repaired six pre-existing Active snapshots whose linked tests no longer resolved: five because this migration renamed or removed the test (011f0efd remap test deleted since remapping is gone by design, 6ffb9d11 traversal-path test now missing-derived-audio, 7b2d7d89 legacy-playability test now reconciles-playability, f17bc992 part-path test now keyed-by-speech-block-id, f5c39900 resplit test now keeps-later-audio), and e4b08ab6 which was already broken at session start by an earlier rename to test_ensure_default_operation_state_skips_audio_blocks. audit traceability and audit coverage both report OK.
